$comment: The 2025 closing Spotify totals the 2026 running-streams ledgers subtract from. ChartMasters' date picker serves only the last fifteen days, so a close is never re-readable there; each one carries where it came from. A ledger with no close here stays on kworb's dailies. From 8 Oct 2026 every close is checked against ChartMasters' own December 2025 point, which its public artist page prints exactly (the 'Streams Over Time' chart, reads/2026-10-08-series.json): Wizkid's and Tems' derived closes equal it to the unit, Asake's and Tyla's were replaced by it, and Burna Boy's corrected close is that point less the February 2026 reallocation.

burna-boy.source: this site's corrected 2025 close — 9,508,991,024 on 31 Dec 2025 less the 309,438,350 Spotify reallocated to two originals in Feb 2026 (/analysis/spotify-unmerge, 21 Aug 2026); ChartMasters through 15 Sep 2026 minus it reproduces the tracker's 1,810,927,983 to the unit; the 9,508,991,024 is ChartMasters' own 'December 2025' point (the running total through 31 Dec 2025) on its public artist page chartmasters.org/artist/burna-boy/, captured 2026-10-08 05:04 UTC in docs/sourcing/chartmasters/reads/2026-10-08-series.json, the same figure /analysis/spotify-unmerge has printed since 21 Aug. Do NOT subtract that raw point instead: it would count the reallocation as 2026 streams lost (2026 = 1,644,482,152 on the 5 Oct total)

wizkid.source: confirmed 8 Oct 2026: ChartMasters' own 'December 2025' point (the running total through 31 Dec 2025) on its public artist page chartmasters.org/artist/wizkid/, captured 2026-10-08 05:07 UTC in docs/sourcing/chartmasters/reads/2026-10-08-series.json, equal to the unit to the value derived 17 Sep 2026 (ChartMasters total through 15 Sep (11,765,176,755) minus @BurnaBoyStats' 2026 figure of the same day (1,808,204,727))

tems.source: confirmed 8 Oct 2026: ChartMasters' own 'December 2025' point (the running total through 31 Dec 2025) on its public artist page chartmasters.org/artist/tems/, captured 2026-10-08 05:07 UTC in docs/sourcing/chartmasters/reads/2026-10-08-series.json, equal to the unit to the value derived 17 Sep 2026 (ChartMasters total through 15 Sep (6,248,869,339) minus @BurnaBoyStats' 2026 figure of the same day (1,807,644,361))

asake.source: ChartMasters' own 'December 2025' point (the running total through 31 Dec 2025) on its public artist page chartmasters.org/artist/asake/, captured 2026-10-08 05:07 UTC in docs/sourcing/chartmasters/reads/2026-10-08-series.json; replaced 8 Oct 2026 the close derived 22 Sep (2,904,229,392 = ChartMasters through 15 Sep minus this site's kworb-daily ledger on kworb's 16 Sep page), which carried that ledger's small error and sat 79,583 high
